name: onepic-template-studio
description: Standalone single-image visual prompt template library with 576 normalized templates.

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run validate && npm run test
scripts.build:workspaces: npm run build -w @onepic/contracts && npm run build -w @onepic/client && npm run build -w @onepic/test-support && npm run build -w @onepic/api && npm run build -w @onepic/worker && npm run build -w @onepic/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @onepic/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @onepic/client && npm run typecheck -w @onepic/test-support && npm run typecheck -w @onepic/api && npm run typecheck:test -w @onepic/api && npm run typecheck:test -w @onepic/worker && npm run typecheck -w @onepic/worker && npm run typecheck -w @onepic/web
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts vitest.integration.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts vitest.integration.config.ts playwright.config.ts
